generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Hub-motor pickup: 109 kWh pack, DC up to about 150 kW (one source). Built Sep 2022-Jun 2023 in small numbers (sources say 31 to about 450); Lordstown filed for Chapter 11 on 27 Jun 2023. EPA MY2023 only. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lordstown_Endurance ; https://insideevs.com/news/663128/lordstown-resumes-production-deliveries-endurance-ev-pickup/
